analysis.reason: 3일 연속 하락세(-6.59%, -11.03%, -6.08%)로 RSI가 31.2로 과매도 구간에 진입했으나, MACD 히스토그램은 약세 수렴을 유지하며 방향 전환 신호가 명확하지 않다. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율이 2.52로 급증했으나, 이는 하락폭 확대에 따른 반대매매 또는 투매 가능성을 시사한다. 따라서 추가 하락 시 지지선(75,565원)을 확인하며 관망한다.
analysis.reasonEn: The price has fallen for 3 consecutive days (-6.59%, -11.03%, -6.08%), pushing RSI to 31.2 in oversold territory. However, the MACD histogram maintains bearish convergence, lacking a clear reversal signal. The volume ratio of 2.52 (2.52x 5-day average) is a surge, suggesting potential panic selling or short-covering on the decline. Therefore, we observe and await confirmation at the support level ($75,565) on further downside.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($89,395) vs SMA5/20/50 ($102,480/$113,821/$125,226) — Below short/mid-term trends, bearish.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($108,919/$86,325) — Below SMA100, above SMA200, mixed long-term trend.
· 52-week Position (42.9%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (31.2→31.3) — Oversold territory sustained, no reversal signal.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-2123.2669→-2123.2669) — Bearish convergence maintained, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Near Lower Band $91,425) — Approaching lower band, band width 39.35% is wide.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($75,565) — Based on Pivot S1 ($67,733) and 52-week low ($41,860).
· Swing Resistance ($89,550) — Just above current price, short-term resistance.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Lower Low / Lower Low) — Downtrend continuation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (2.52x) — Surge, suggesting potential panic selling or short-covering on the price decline.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Distribution Phase) — RSI entered oversold but MACD maintains bearish convergence; observe and await confirmation at support on further decline.
